prior_failed_run.reason: Hosted dependency resolution failed before source compilation; the pinned template lacked an explicit Maven Central plugin repository. The successor adds it without changing dependency pins.

scope: Inspects the original settings model ABI, exact injected list/context call, bootstrap, stock-result wrapper and optional decoder guards; compares the remainder of the original code, handlers, resources, native files and assets. Debug items and signing are outside the comparison.
limits: Synthetic callback and preferences stand-ins are not an Android UI or player test
No phone installation, playback, device acceptance, model or personal media operation
No complete FLAC download/provider acceptance or whole-file codec proof
No same-signer update or verified handoff of installed private downloads
Hosted prototype only; existing public release/feed was not changed
